title: Stoa Architecture Config
description: The declared layers of the project under analysis, supplied via `stoa analyze --architecture <file>` (stoa.architecture.json). Files are assigned to the FIRST layer whose include globs match their path relative to the analysis root; edges between different layers are allowed only when listed in `allow`; `forbidPackages` bans external packages per layer. A file without a layer is unknown and never judged. It describes the INTENDED architecture; it proves nothing about the code.

version.description: Config version, for change tracking; not tied to Stoa's own versions.

layers.description: In priority order: a file belongs to the first layer that matches it.

allow.description: Permitted dependency directions between DIFFERENT layers; edges within one layer are always allowed.

include.description: POSIX globs (picomatch), relative to the analysis root, e.g. lib/Pages/**.

packages.description: Package names: a Dart package (`http` for package:http/…), `dart:io`, or an npm package (`axios`, `@scope/name`).
